item.title: Nicky Campbell Turns Heads in Alexander McQueen Eyewear
item.description: TikTok creator and evening carpet host Nicky Campbell made a striking appearance in Alexander McQueen AM0534S 003 eyewear. Styled in classic black with bold yellow lenses, the statement silhouette delivered a sharp, high-contrast edge, perfectly complementing his confident on-camera presence and modern red-carpet flair.

item.title: Ellie Goulding Steps Out in Willy Chavarria Sunglasses
item.description: Ellie Goulding marked her pregnancy reveal with unmistakable style, stepping out in Willy Chavarria Bad Boy sunglasses. The bold black frames, defined by a sharp oversized silhouette, added a confident edge to the moment—perfectly balancing personal news with a strong, fashion-forward statement.

item.title: Jamie Campbell Bower in Tom Ford Sunglasses
item.description: Stranger Things star Jamie Campbell Bower was spotted in London during the show’s promo run wearing Tom Ford Fausto TF711 01A sunglasses. The sleek black frame, defined by its sharp, structured lines, brought a refined yet brooding edge—perfectly echoing his dark, cinematic on-screen presence as Vecna.
